segments.he: מר' נחמן מטולטשין ז"ל שהלך עם מוהרנ"ת ז"ל בתענית אסתר לפנות ערב עם המגילה להתפלל מנחה. ור' נחמן הי' כבר בגילופין (אופגראסט) בשביל שכבר קרוב לפורים, אמר לו מהרנ"ת ז"ל "נחמן ווייס ביסטו אזי אופגרומט פאה געסט אז דארפסט נאך זאגין (אסייעין) "כי בצרה גדולה אנחנו" (שאומרים עננו בשמ"ע של תפלת המנחה שהיא תענית ציבור):
segments.en: Reb Natan's custom during the Three Weeks was to recite the kinos [lamentations] with tallis and tefillin. And on the eve of Tisha B'Av from midday he would close himself in a deep cellar and remain there locked in weeping, wailing, and strange voices until past midday of Tisha B'Av itself — and this was his custom every year after Rabbainu's passing. He could not cool his mind until he would see Rabbainu. And the Rav Reb Shmuel Yitzchak of Tcheryn — one of the greatest disciples of Rabbainu — was once with Reb Natan on Tisha B'Av and witnessed his custom as described. When Reb Natan emerged from the cellar, his face full of hope, Reb Shmuel Yitzchak was struck at his appearance and said [words of praise for Rabbainu] — adding that he had not known Rabbainu's greatness as well until that very year.
